alex.m: Quick question — during active/active failover sims I saw edge sessions being accepted in the standby region and causing stale writes. How do we want to scope session tokens and routing to avoid cross-region data leakage for residency-constrained tenants?

camille: TL;DR: region-scope sessions + strict write routing. Longer: each tenant should carry a residency tag (legal flag). For tenants with "residency=local" we should: 1) scope session tokens to their resident region, 2) reject cross-region writes at the proxy, 3) allow read fallback under explicit consent.

jordan: Saw same in the sim. Concrete idea: make tokens include a region claim and validate at edge proxy. Example: ```jwt.payload.region = "eu-west-1"``` Proxy rejects if incoming request region != token.region for write verbs. That prevents a retry hitting the wrong primary.

sana: Adding: gateway should set an `X-Region-Intent` header (derived from client affinity heuristics). If header missing and tenant has residency flag, return 409 or 401 depending on auth state. For read fallback we can permit `X-Read-Fallback: true` and log an audit entry.

ops-bot: deployment-note: feature-flag `regional-token-enforce` is on for canary 5% starting 2026-05-12. Rollback automated to OFF if error-rate > 0.5% for 10m.

camille: Important ops detail: rolling this out requires a migration path for old tokens. Plan: accept legacy tokens for a grace TTL (30 days). On token validation failure, return 401 + `WWW-Authenticate: region-refresh` so clients re-auth. That avoids forcing a coordinated reissue.

alex.m: Actionable list: 1) Add region claim to session JWTs and validation in proxy. 2) Proxy-level policy to drop cross-region writes for `residency=local` tenants. 3) Add gated read-fallback with audit logging + `X-Read-Fallback` contract. 4) Migration plan for legacy tokens (30d TTL + auth retry).

jordan: I'll own the proxy change (feature-flagged). Will add tests for retry storms and token-scoping. Also will add an integration test where a client retry attempts cross-region write and should be rejected. Expect PR by next Tue.

sana: I'll update routing table rules and the runbook for operator-driven failovers (step to toggle read-fallback vs strict). Will add sample `curl` snippets and runbook checks.

alex.m: Great. We'll sync this into the arch follow-up doc and mention the canary window. Quick sync on Thurs 10:30? :thumbsup:

jordan: +1

camille: +1
